doc.projectIntro: This quote covers a 100Mbps Openserve fibre link and a 3CX VoIP line for Nova Nexus Group, provided on a 24-month term and billed monthly, together with the once-off fibre installation and a cordless VoIP handset. Wi-Fi is quoted separately. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Once-off installation and activation of the Openserve fibre link at your premises, including router configuration and handover.

items.description: Fanvil W610D — 20SIP Portable DECT IP Phone
items.detail: Cordless DECT handset with base station, supporting up to 20 SIP accounts. Supplied configured and registered to your 3CX system.
100Mbps uncapped fibre connectivity via Openserve, billed monthly.
One 3CX VoIP line, billed monthly. Additional lines can be added at any time at the same rate of R99 per line per month ex VAT.
Outgoing calls, billed monthly in arrears. Charged per second, so you pay only for the seconds you actually use.

doc.summaryNote: Call charges are additional and billed monthly in arrears at R0.50 per minute, charged per second. Wi-Fi (Ubiquiti UniFi) is not included here and will be quoted separately.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
The fibre and VoIP service is provided on a 24-month term, billed monthly.
Calls are billed monthly in arrears at R0.50 per minute, charged per second.
Additional 3CX VoIP lines may be added at any time at R99 per line per month ex VAT.
The once-off installation and hardware are payable on acceptance, prior to installation.
Service provisioning is subject to Openserve line feasibility at the site.
Manufacturer warranty applies to all hardware supplied.
Wi-Fi equipment is excluded and will be quoted separately.
